attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 17 Ιουνίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. The corpus keeps no Joseph the Anchorite; the page gives no country, no monastery and no year, only that he was famous for self-restraint and humility, that he withdrew with his disciples to escape praise, that he reposed in peace, and that the Evergetinos writes of him. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the life page.
